# Earthology365

> A travel and culture publication featuring curated guides to Europe's most beautiful destinations, with special focus on Greece, France, Italy, and Mediterranean heritage sites.

Earthology365 provides bucket-list travel guides, cultural exploration articles, and destination rankings covering European capitals, Greek islands, French landmarks, Italian hidden gems, and seasonal travel experiences. The site emphasizes both popular attractions and off-the-beaten-path discoveries across the Mediterranean and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Greece travel
- Greek islands (Lefkada, Cyclades, Dodecanese, Crete)
- France destinations (Paris, Marseille, Versailles)
- Italy travel (Rome, Lazio)
- European capitals and cities
- Mediterranean culture and heritage
- Cultural heritage sites
- Beach destinations
- Seasonal travel (Christmas markets, Easter traditions, fall foliage)
- UNESCO heritage sites
- Palace and garden tourism
- Sustainable and digital detox travel
- European architecture and art
- Island hopping guides

## Greece & Greek Islands

- [Top 10 Beaches with Bluest Waters in Greece](https://earthology365.com/top-10-beaches-with-bluest-waters-in-greece): Greek beach guide featuring Aghiophilli Beach, Lefkada & Cyclades
- [10 Beautiful Places In Greece You Have To Visit](https://earthology365.com/10-beautiful-places-in-greece-you-have-to-visit): Essential Greece travel guide featuring Santorini's volcanic landscapes
- [8 Hidden Gems in the Dodecanese islands](https://earthology365.com/8-hidden-gems-in-the-dodecanese-islands): Greek island hopping guide to Dodecanese including Halki near Rhodes
- [The Greek Islands: How were they Named?](https://earthology365.com/the-greek-islands-how-were-they-named): Greek island etymology exploring mythology behind names like Cephalonia

## France Travel Guides
